name: EIC Advanced Innovation Challenges (AIC)  Stage 1 PoC (EUR 300K)

sub.label: 0.1 Which 2026 AIC Challenge
prompts: Pick ONE: (1) Accelerating Physical AI: Embodied Intelligence for the Next Frontier of AI-Powered Robotics; (2) Translating Disruptive New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) into Practice.

sub.label: 1.1 Mapping to the Challenge
prompts: How does the proposal map to the specific demand challenge identified by the Programme Manager?

sub.label: 1.2 Transformative potential
prompts: Why is this not incremental  what new category of capability does it enable?

sub.label: 2.1 Commercialisation pathway
prompts: Even at Stage 1, describe how Stage 2 will mature toward market.

sub.label: 3.1 9-month PoC work plan
prompts: What is the demonstration concept and its 9-month proof-of-concept plan? Deliverable expected at month 9 (prototype, dataset, validation report).

sub.label: 3.2 Team
prompts: Single applicant: start-up / SME / RPO. Describe the team.

sub.label: 3.3 Budget
prompts: EUR 300K lump sum  broken down by WP.

documents.title: Ethics Self-Assessment annex (incl. AI ethics + bioethics for NAMs)

hand_offs.chat_cta: How does my project map to AIC Challenge 1 (Physical AI) or Challenge 2 (NAMs)?
hand_offs.comply_cta: AI Act Annex III screening for Physical AI applications
